# FLX-3115: two generator plugin entry points have one name

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

A plugin is named by its entry point, so exactly one entry point of that name must exist. When two installed distributions register the same name, the engine does not take the first on sys.path, because which one comes first depends on the environment and on the current directory. The message names every distribution and version that registers the name. Uninstall all but the distribution the bundle pins. Nothing was imported.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3115
```
